method: Fresh native XCTest screenshots inspected in contact sheets. Six updated-runtime originals, including continuous-flow phone screens and tablet completion, were also inspected individually at full size. The final uncropped preview and all three final iPhone native picker contact sheets were inspected.
checked: Phone and iPad change review prioritizes the actual diff with a fixed Save and Export action and separate Save for Later action.
Saved-for-later and cancelled export states show saved status inline and a prominent Continue Export action, with explicit return navigation.
Wrong-farm failure leaves the saved copy available and provides a visible directory re-selection action.
Phone and iPad target comparison distinguish local saved copy from current game content and retain disabled write action before required acknowledgement.
iPad real system directory picker and file-export picker both open twice; cancellation returns to the same export stage with explicit saved-copy-retained wording.
iPad cancellation returns to the same edited value and the library clearly shows Saved, Pending Export.
Phone and iPad export completion screens explicitly state both files were written and verified, retained target backup, and a visible Finish, Return to Editor action.
Phone and iPad changed-target flows show both required acknowledgement switches and an enabled write action only after both are on; failure returns to a safe retry state.
Successful phone and iPad library screens show Verified Written to Game Directory; pending state remains distinct in interrupted flows.

Three full-screen iPhone originals from one successful continuous export test were inspected before composing the preview; composed preview inspected afterward with no screenshot crop or text overlays.
Preview middle panel uses the same successful test's native after-toggle screenshot: complete local/game comparison, game-exited switch on, enabled write action; refreshed preview inspected.

Final successful iPhone run shows real directory and file-export pickers each presented twice; native Back navigation from the nested app folder through My iPhone to Browse exposes Cancel. Each cancellation returns to the same export stage with saved-copy-retained wording, then review offers Continue Export and the library remains Saved, Pending Export; no false success is shown.
